author: claude-opus-5-5

objective.text: Wave 1, stage 0: file Stage-19-valid dossiers for claim-ready decided-YES Federal Register orders through the Maudslay conveyor's stateless mode (one request per stage, no tools), and measure filed dossiers, controls caught and list-price cost per filed claim against the agent route.

precondition: The stateless gauge (research/stateless-calls-2026-11-24) must report GO_STATELESS before this batch reserves any order; on KEEP_AGENT_ROUTE or an incomplete gauge the batch does not run.

premortem.failure: Stateless reviewers uphold claims the agent arms would block (reviewer quality drop)
premortem.guard: precondition: the paired gauge's stop rule (any missed control, disagreement above 7/85, or more than $2.50 per filed claim keeps the agent route); the batch plants a control per review set and the both-uphold rule is unchanged

premortem.failure: claude -p flags behave differently from the specification (answers lost, tools on, sessions reused)
premortem.guard: the gauge exercises the same STATELESS_TEMPLATE first; validate_worker_command refuses --bare, bypass flags and any non-empty --tools; an unusable answer leaves the order unresolved, not filed

premortem.failure: Large orders blow the 150k prompt cap or cost
premortem.guard: orders over 150k tokens are not sent stateless (listed prompt_over_cap); --batch-usd 40 caps the batch and the conveyor stops launching when spend plus in-flight forecast would pass it

premortem.failure: Cruden number search or prepare runs past the runner wall or stalls the PC
premortem.guard: the batch runs on the owner's PC, not a GitHub runner; cruden is cached per order under BATCH/stateless/cruden and timed on the first orders before the rest

acknowledged_findings.F-20261118-kiaer-stopped-at-review: Every code guard in the premortem is code the conveyor already runs on main (validate_worker_command, the 150k cutoff, --batch-usd, the planted control and both-uphold rule). The gauge precondition is not code: it is an operator check in RUN.md (read GAUGE_RESULTS.json; stop unless GO_STATELESS), stated as such.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261113-conveyor-audit: MEASURES.json records per-request prompt size, cache reads and writes and output per model call (stateless.calls), and the stage-0 finding will compare at the reserve-to-publish boundary with request counts, not summed tokens alone.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: One Bentham-ranked action only (production.claim_ready.yes.fr, measured 7/30); claim-kit admission refuses orders outside it; stage 0 is one lane and 30 orders.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: No undecided orders: --stateless refuses undecided actions, and this plan names only a decided-YES production action.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261028-4: Prepare runs after the 2026-11-24/25 Pinakes, tracker and Bentham regenerations on main, so packets carry the current working-text grades.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261018-7: No URL fetching in this batch: evidence comes from held texts with sha256 receipts that the conveyor checks before any model call.

review.basis: Owner in chat 2026-11-25 01:34 ET: 'can you /goal wave #1 stateless? you can even take over my terminal' (Kean D-20261125-maudslay-wave1).
